comparison.objective: Selects a shelf liner by friction testing, lays it on a 20-degree rack, and stabilizes a glass; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Material/friction discrimination and liner placement differ from precision mandrel alignment, impact control, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: A released glass must remain on the inclined lined rack; candidate requires four tang fractures and deposits with coils and shell retained undamaged.
comparison.reason: Both involve physical contact properties, but one tests empirical friction selection and stabilization while the other tests localized fracture and containment.
